topic: Theory: the true final threat in One Piece is the last Ancient Weapon, Uranus, not Imu
title: One Piece's Final Boss Isn't Imu, It's Uranus
description: Vegapunk's broadcast said the Ancient Weapons flooded the world and still exist. Two of the three are located, so what if the last one is the real final boss? Is Imu the final villain, or is it Uranus?
comment: Is Imu the final villain, or is the last Ancient Weapon the real threat? Pick one.

lines.text: The final boss of One Piece might not be Imu. It might be Uranus.

shot.fallback: dark ruler on a throne beside a glowing ancient weapon

lines.text: Hear me out, because Oda already told us in Vegapunk's broadcast.

shot.fallback: scientist hologram broadcast to the world

lines.text: In chapter 1115, he says the Ancient Weapons raised the sea by two hundred meters.

shot.fallback: world map with sunken continents under rising sea

lines.text: Whole continents went under, and he says the weapons still exist today.
So the Great War isn't over. It's just waiting.

shot.search: Joy Boy Great War Void Century
shot.fallback: ancient war scene with a figure in a white outfit

lines.text: Count the weapons. Poseidon is Shirahoshi, and Pluton sleeps under Wano.

shot.fallback: giant mermaid princess and ancient warship under a mountain

lines.text: That's two accounted for. Uranus is the only one nobody has located.
Vegapunk and Ivankov think a weapon powered by the Mother Flame destroyed Lulusia.

shot.fallback: kingdom burning under a huge flame

lines.text: It might be Uranus, it might not. But it points to something still hidden.

shot.fallback: revolutionary leader looking at a ruined kingdom

lines.text: People say Imu is the final villain, because he sits on the throne.

shot.fallback: shadowy ruler on a throne in a vast palace

lines.text: But beating Imu doesn't turn the weapons off.

shot.fallback: hero facing a shadowy ruler in a ruined hall

lines.text: Here's my read: whoever controls the last weapon decides how this story ends.

shot.fallback: glowing weapon between a hero and a dark ruler

lines.text: Because the final boss of One Piece might not be Imu...

shot.fallback: dark ruler on a throne beside a glowing ancient weapon

self_check.hook: claim in line 1 names One Piece and Imu

published.comment: Is Imu the final villain, or is the last Ancient Weapon the real threat? Pick one.
